Examples with invented names: two albums both called Evening, one by Mira and one by Noel, support BOTH artists. Two people called Alex born1901 and1873 support BOTH dates. A player practicing golf AND tennis supports BOTH sports. A passage saying London is a birthplace makes London a wrong_argument for a birth-DATE question.
